description: dati.cittametropolitana.fi.it: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dati.cittametropolitana.fi.it. Coverage: the area served by dati.cittametropolitana.fi.it. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zone territoriali di competenza delle strade in gestione - Città Metro; PTCP 2013 - Quadro Conoscitivo QC04.1 Rete stradale e ferroviaria - Ci; PTCP 2013 - Carta dello Statuto del Territorio Art. 31 Ferrovie e line. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
